incident: Colonial Pipeline - DarkSide ransomware (intrusion 29 April, ransom note 7 May 2021)

sources.title: Joseph Blount, written testimony, U.S. Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs, 8 June 2021
sources.what_it_gave: detection ('just before 5:00 AM EDT' on 7 May an employee 'identified the ransom note on a system in the IT network'); Operations Supervisor at Control Center issued stop-work order, shutdown began ~5:55, all 5,500 miles confirmed shut by 6:10 AM EDT to keep malware off the OT network; entry via 'legacy VPN profile that was not intended to be in use'; Mandiant retained; restart evening 12 May; 950 employees, 29 refineries, 260 delivery points, 13 states

sources.title: CISA/FBI Joint Advisory AA21-131A: DarkSide Ransomware: Best Practices for Preventing Business Disruption
sources.what_it_gave: DarkSide deployed against the pipeline company's IT network; no indication OT was directly affected; company proactively disconnected certain OT systems; DarkSide initial access via phishing / remotely accessible accounts and systems / VDI (T1566, T1190, T1133); Cobalt Strike C2, RDP persistence, T1486

sources.title: Dark Reading (9 Jun 2021): Colonial Pipeline CEO: Ransomware Attack Started via Pilfered 'Legacy' VPN Account
sources.what_it_gave: VPN account had only single-factor authentication; complex password; ransom note found on IT network at 5:00 a.m. ET 7 May; legacy VPN profile shut down; DOJ seized 63.7 BTC (~USD 2.3m) of the payment

sources.title: The Hacker News / Bloomberg (Mandiant, Charles Carmakal): Hackers Breached Colonial Pipeline Using Compromised VPN Password
sources.what_it_gave: VPN account unused but active, no MFA; password later found in a dark-web batch of leaked passwords; first foothold 29 April 2021; ~100 GB stolen; USD 4.4m ransom paid; operations halted nearly a week

sources.title: The Stack: How the Colonial Pipeline hack happened (Mandiant findings)
sources.what_it_gave: Mandiant saw no attacker activity before 29 April; no evidence of phishing against the account owner; Carmakal: attackers did not move from the IT network to the OT network; no CISO at the time

sources.title: BNN Bloomberg (9 May 2021): Colonial hackers stole data Thursday ahead of pipeline shutdown
sources.what_it_gave: about 100 GB exfiltrated from the network in roughly two hours on Thursday 6 May, then computers encrypted; double extortion; Mandiant assisting

sources.title: BankInfoSecurity: Colonial CEO at Senate Hearing Details Ransomware Attack
sources.what_it_gave: legacy VPN 'essentially invisible' to IT, no MFA; decision to pay 7 May, payment 8 May; seven finance systems back online 8 June; FBI contacted the morning of the attack
